title: 5分钟生成1分钟电影级战争视频，4个镜头结构
description: 5分钟生成1分钟电影级战争视频，4个镜头结构。逼真的中东沙漠村庄步兵战斗场景。
prompt: 统一风格设定（全片一致）：电影级写实战争纪录片质感；现代中东沙漠村庄；主色调为沙黄、灰褐与烟尘灰；正午强光形成硬阴影；空气中持续有浮尘、火药烟与细小碎屑；手持摄影轻微抖动，优先低机位与贴地跟拍；士兵为现代轻步兵装备（防弹衣、头盔、通讯设备），不出现可识别国旗或徽章；整体氛围紧张、克制、残酷。 镜头1：小队沿狭窄巷道推进。低矮土坯房与破损混凝土墙在强光下形成高反差阴影，地面散落砖石、废弃生活物件与弹壳。镜头贴地从小队后方缓慢推入，队员贴墙前进、枪口指向转角，远处传来风声与金属碰撞回响，节奏压抑。 镜头2：转角处突然爆发短促近距离交火。士兵迅速下蹲压墙，子弹命中墙面扬起尘土与碎屑，短促枪焰照亮阴影区。镜头快速平移并伴随轻微晃动，窗口后可见模糊敌方轮廓。画面强调空间狭窄、压迫感与突发性。 镜头3：小队穿过巷道抵达半坍塌建筑入口。跟随一名士兵越肩进入内部，光线骤暗，仅有阳光从破洞斜射进入，尘埃在光柱中漂浮。队员以手势沟通，表情紧绷，远处枪声断续回荡，情绪从混乱转为高度警戒。 镜头4：小队占据受损屋顶高点俯瞰村庄巷网。夕照逆光下，士兵形成剪影，枪口仍指向未知威胁方向。镜头缓慢后拉，风沙在空中翻卷，远处村庄表面安静却危机未解。结尾保持开放式紧张，不给出明确胜负。

title: 燃烧军车的城市战争航拍镜头
description: 电影级无人机镜头捕捉城市战斗的余波。展示 Seedance 2.0 生成逼真战争场景的能力，包含详细的破坏效果和氛围渲染。
prompt: 生成一段战争纪实风格航拍镜头：无人机高空俯拍一条被战火摧毁的城市十字路口，中心是一辆被击毁的装甲车，车体持续燃烧并冒出浓黑烟柱。道路布满碎石、金属残骸和破损路障，两侧建筑外立面焦黑、窗户破碎。天空阴沉偏灰，整体色调去饱和，强调悲怆与压抑。镜头语言从高空建立镜头缓慢下降到中高空，保持稳定推进，展示破坏规模与空间关系。火焰、烟雾、热浪、灰尘运动要真实，细节具备纪录片级可信度，画面加入轻微胶片颗粒。

title: IMAX风格沙漠沙尘暴场景，Denis Villeneuve美学
description: IMAX风格沙漠沙尘暴场景，Denis Villeneuve美学。包含时间戳多镜头结构。
prompt: 风格：IMAX 70mm，Denis Villeneuve 式冷峻史诗感，低饱和高对比。 极远全景：巨大沙暴墙吞没地平线，装甲车队在前景高速撤离，突出“人类渺小”。 车内主观镜头：驾驶舱剧烈震动，挡风玻璃被沙粒连续冲击，仪表红灯闪烁，角色大喊“最大推力！”，紧张值拉满。 高潮慢动作：领头车冲上沙丘腾空，剪影悬于黑色沙暴前，沙暴内部闪电划过，碎屑掠过镜头，落地瞬间切黑。要求镜头转场干净，音画节奏层层推进。

title: 仅用3张参考图和简单提示词生成多镜头打斗场景

The robot suddenly malfunctions and falls face down onto the asphalt. The woman stops, turns, cautiously pokes the motionless robot with her cane, then picks up something from her bag before continuing on her way. Quiet urban street, cinematic, realistic, neutral colors.

title: 直升机向熔岩坑倾倒冰块
description: 观看一桶冰被投入活火山口，引发爆炸性的烟雾反应。
prompt: A dynamic shot from a helicopter window. A woman with safety gear and headphones, holding a red bucket full of ice, leans out, smiling. She then pours the ice directly into an active, glowing lava pit below. The camera tilts down and zooms slightly to capture the ice impacting the molten lava, causing violent bubbling and small explosions. Suddenly, a massive plume of dense white smoke and debris erupts forcefully from the crater, engulfing the view. The camera quickly pulls back and shakes intensely, then cuts to the woman inside the helicopter, looking surprised and startled, partially obscured by the smoke. Realistic style, cinematic lighting.

title: 北极熊袭击冰屋
description: 一个人被困在冰屋内，一只北极熊猛烈地破坏冰屋，营造出紧张的求生场景。
prompt: A person in a red arctic suit enters an igloo in a vast, snow-covered arctic landscape under a cloudy sky. A massive polar bear slowly approaches the igloo from the side. The polar bear aggressively smashes the igloo entrance with its paw, sending ice chunks flying. The bear then climbs on top and repeatedly smashes the igloo roof, causing it to collapse further, trapping the person inside with falling ice. The person looks up in terror as the polar bear stares menacingly down into the broken igloo. Cinematic, realistic style, eye-level camera. Dynamic motion.

title: 大猩猩在屋顶摧毁直升机
description: 一名男子在高楼建筑上惊险逃脱一只巨型大猩猩的狂暴袭击，惊心动魄的场景就此展开。
prompt: A man in a business suit runs frantically across a skyscraper rooftop. A colossal gorilla emerges from behind a towering building, smashes a 'RESCUE' helicopter with its immense fist. The man ducks and slides for cover as the helicopter is destroyed. Cinematic, realistic, action-movie style, with a dynamic tracking shot following the man, transitioning to a close-up on the gorilla's action.

title: 直升机视角向熔岩倾倒冰块
description: 一个惊险的空中视角捕捉到一名人员从直升机上向活跃的熔岩火山口倾倒一桶冰，导致了一场戏剧性的爆炸性蒸汽反应。
prompt: A point-of-view shot from inside a helicopter, looking down and slightly forward. A person wearing a blue jacket, headphones, and gloves is seen from the waist up, holding a large grey bucket filled with ice. They tilt the bucket, pouring the ice directly into a vibrant red, molten lava crater far below. As the ice hits the lava, a massive, explosive plume of white and reddish steam and smoke erupts, billowing upwards and outwards. The surrounding landscape is dark, solidified lava rock, with the ocean visible in the distant background under a bright sky. Realistic, documentary style, intense, dynamic motion.

title: 空中视角向海洋倾倒熔岩
description: 空中视角捕捉到一名男子从直升机上将熔融熔岩倾倒入开阔的海洋，造成了一场戏剧性的蒸汽飞溅。
prompt: Aerial view from inside a helicopter, a man in a headset and protective gloves holds a bucket of glowing molten lava. He slowly tilts the bucket, pouring the bright orange lava in a thick stream into the deep blue ocean below. The camera pans down to track the lava's descent, showing it impacting the water with an enormous, explosive cloud of white steam and spray, completely obscuring the view. Realistic, cinematic, bright daylight.

title: 过肩镜头：冰入熔岩湖
description: 见证从直升机上将冰倒入滚烫的熔岩池时，那不可思议的爆炸性反应。
prompt: A person from inside a helicopter pours a bucket of ice cubes into a vast, glowing red molten lava lake below. The camera is positioned over their shoulder, looking down as the ice streams into the lava, instantly creating a colossal, rapidly expanding white cloud of steam and smoke that erupts upwards. The scene is a dramatic, high-definition view of a volcanic landscape, showcasing the intense reaction between ice and lava.

title: 巨型水果上的微型工人特写
description: 微小的建筑工人在一个异想天开的户外环境中与超大型水果互动。
prompt: A series of hyper-realistic macro close-up shots depicting miniature construction workers, dressed in bright safety gear, meticulously working on oversized fruits in an autumn outdoor setting with fallen leaves. Each scene features a different fruit: an apple being 'excavated' and 'sliced' with tiny tools, a half-coconut with workers setting up scaffolding and pulling ropes inside, a giant blueberry being 'drilled' and 'lifted' with a miniature cherry picker and excavator, a large strawberry being 'harvested' by workers on ladders cutting out pieces into crates, and a halved kiwi fruit with workers 'drilling' into its core. The camera maintains a shallow depth of field, focusing sharply on the tiny workers and fruit textures, with smooth, slow zooms and pans to highlight the intricate activity, giving a whimsical and detailed stop-motion aesthetic.

title: 直升机投下冰块序列镜头
description: 一块巨大的冰块从直升机上被投入深海，创造了一场爆炸性的水下奇观。
prompt: A thrilling sequence: First, a man wearing safety gear pushes a large, clear ice block out of a helicopter flying high above the deep blue ocean. The camera is positioned inside the helicopter, looking out. Second, the ice block falls, hitting the water with a significant splash, seen from an aerial perspective. Third, an underwater shot shows the massive ice block sinking rapidly, creating a powerful stream of bubbles. Finally, from an aerial view looking down, a swirling vortex forms on the ocean surface, followed by a colossal geyser of water and ice exploding upwards, violently splashing the helicopter.

title: 冰块投入温泉间歇泉
description: 一名女子从直升机上向一个绿松石色的温泉投下一大块冰，引发了一场壮观的间歇泉喷发。
prompt: A dynamic video starting with a close-up of a woman in a helicopter, wearing a headset and gloves, pushing a large rectangular block of ice out of the open helicopter door. The camera then switches to an overhead view from the helicopter, showing the ice block falling into a vibrant turquoise hot spring surrounded by a dark, barren, volcanic landscape with hills in the background. The scene transitions to an underwater perspective as the ice block plunges into the water, creating a large, bubbling splash. Finally, the camera returns to the overhead view from the helicopter, capturing the immense eruption of a geyser from the hot spring, sending a massive plume of white steam and water high into the air, obscuring the view. The overall style is realistic and vivid.

title: 微型巨石摧毁道路与建筑
description: 一个逼真的微型立体模型捕捉到一块巨石从山坡滚落，在充满动作感的场景中摧毁了一座加油站和一间木屋。
prompt: A realistic miniature diorama showcases a massive round boulder being released from a high mechanical platform. The boulder rolls rapidly down a winding mountain road, narrowly missing a red school bus, then violently crashes through a gas station building and sign. It continues its destructive path, rolling over a train bridge, and finally demolishes a detailed log cabin. The camera dynamically follows the boulder's entire high-speed descent and destruction, ending with a close-up as it settles on the ground amidst dust and debris.

title: 直升机向海洋倾泻熔岩引发爆炸
description: 一名男子驾驶直升机戏剧性地将熔融的熔岩倾倒入海洋，引发了巨大的蒸汽爆炸。
prompt: A man in a helicopter wearing headphones and safety gear, seen from inside the open door, carefully pours a bucket of glowing orange molten lava into the pristine turquoise ocean below. The camera follows the lava stream as it dramatically hits the water, creating a massive, violent explosion of white steam and water that engulfs the helicopter, blocking the view. The background features a distant lush coastline and mountains under a cloudy sky, with small boats scattered in the water. Cinematic, realistic, high-definition video.

title: 微型森林城镇火灾俯拍镜头
description: 一个超写实的森林与城镇微型场景被一场迅速蔓延的灾难性野火吞噬，伴随着爆炸和建筑倒塌。
prompt: A hyperrealistic miniature model of a vast pine forest and a small rural town engulfed in a catastrophic wildfire. Intense, rapidly spreading flames consume the trees, illuminating the smoke-filled, orange sky. A winding two-lane road with a fleeing pickup truck cuts through the landscape. Structures like a gas station, a power pole, a lookout tower, a small cabin, and a church are consumed by the blaze, collapsing and exploding in sequence. The camera performs a slow, sweeping crane shot, moving from left to right across the devastating scene, showcasing the full scale of the destruction.

title: 风格化人形聚散成星
description: 色彩鲜艳的风格化人形从一条线变换成一个复杂的星形阵型，然后恢复原状，背景是明亮的黄色。
prompt: Eight stylized human figures, adorned with vibrant, swirling organic patterns in distinct colors (blue, green, orange, pink, red, brown-black), are arranged in a row. The central blue figure crouches, while others stand with arms crossed. They dynamically transform into a symmetrical, radial formation where their bodies interlock to form a star shape, with the blue figure performing an inverted acrobatic pose at the center. The figures then fluidly revert to their initial standing positions. The scene is set against a plain, bright yellow background. The animation features a clean, stylized 3D rendering with minimal camera movement, primarily a static wide shot that slightly zooms in and out to frame the action.
